integrity: The universal interval is proved algebraically from the published cone-angle/Brocard identity and a complete optimization on the fixed-angle circular section; deterministic computation is supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to nondegenerate Euclidean triangles.
The originality search was targeted; an equivalent extremal statement could exist in older triangle-geometry literature under different terminology.
title: Sharp side-ratio interval at fixed Brocard angle
